t: This is the Old Royal Naval College, the architectural centrepiece of Maritime Greenwich on the Thames. UNESCO calls the wider site of outstanding universal value, and the finest and most dramatically sited architectural and landscape ensemble in the British Isles. The buildings were commissioned by William III and Mary II. Christopher Wren designed them, working with Nicholas Hawksmoor and John Vanbrugh, and John Webb is also credited as a designer. Wren is the architect of St Paul's Cathedral, and Hawksmoor and Vanbrugh also worked on Blenheim Palace and Castle Howard.
